expectations.text: Identifies 'rewrite to Python' as a solution masquerading as a problem
expectations.evidence: TL;DR explicitly: '重写到 Python 是一个解决方案，不是问题本身'. Five Whys traces to bash maintainability as the root problem.

expectations.text: Decomposes 'hard to maintain' into 2+ specific possible root causes
expectations.evidence: Four specific root causes identified with code references: (1) 代码重复 in init sequences, (2) JSON解析脆弱 jq/awk dual-path, (3) plan-parser.sh 441行过长, (4) 测试执行慢 on Windows

expectations.text: Surfaces the conflict with 'zero compiled dependencies' principle
expectations.evidence: Comparison table row 1 (运行时依赖), '不应该做的事' item 2, assumption audit #2 (Python在所有平台可用 — unknown), constraints table (零编译/运行时依赖 — 真约束)

expectations.text: Recommends investigation before committing to rewrite
expectations.evidence: Goes beyond investigation — provides structural optimization plan (8.5h) as the recommended approach, backed by full codebase audit proving bash code quality is high
'为什么不重写' table with 6 dimensions: 运行时依赖, 代码量, 启动性能, 跨平台, 已有测试, ShellCheck

expectations.text: Includes conditional path — what would justify a rewrite
expectations.evidence: Full '反对方案 (Dissenting Path)' section: 3 conditions that would justify Python + complete 76h execution plan (phases A-I)
